emergency.notes: The hospital advertises emergency and critical care during its published 10:00-22:00 opening hours. Its official contact page sets the last case at 21:30, and an English business reply states that staff may not be available before 10:00 or after 22:00. Older 24-hour claims are therefore not current evidence of after-hours intake.
